PROVISIONAL: D7: every figure marked provisional in `sources` is a stand-in until the owner tests it in game; tunable here. Only the numbers are consumed (utility.FIGURES); editing a source or a note changes nothing.

sources.reveal_range_m: Provisional. How far Fade's Haunt and Sova's Recon Bolt see from where they are; no figure found. In-game test: throw each at a known spot and walk a teammate out along a straight line until they stop being revealed.
sources.skye_flash_range_m: Provisional. How far from its detonation Skye's Guiding Light flashes someone looking at it; no figure found. In-game test: pop it in a long corridor with a teammate at increasing distances, facing it.
sources.leer_cast_range_m: Sourced: Leer's deployment distance is 10 m (can shorten against terrain), https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Leer (game-file sourced) and https://www.thespike.gg/valorant/agents/reyna. Its terrain/height behaviour is untested.
sources.hearing_m: Provisional: each is the footstep range (hearing.json footstep_range_m, itself the owner's to check), set on purpose until measured, never a silent fallback. In-game tests: from From the Shadows' destination, Gatecrash's beacon, Dimensional Drift's exit and Refract's recall, walk a teammate away until the sound stops; note the distance.
sources.molly: Sourced (decision D6, changed 2026-10-09: the owner pointed to https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Deterrent; the figures are on each ability's own page there). How long each damaging molly burns from its landing (`seconds`, capped at its row's end, the actor close) and its radius (`radius_m`). Hot Hands (wiki/Hot_Hands): 4.5 m, 4 s (0.75 s spread, 3.25 s at full size). Incendiary (wiki/Incendiary): 4.5 m, 8 s total (0.25 s explosion, 0.75 s spread, 7 s at full size). Snake Bite (wiki/Snake_Bite): 4.5 m, 6.5 s. Nanoswarm (wiki/Nanoswarm): 4.5 m, 4 s; its row is the damage actor, which starts at activation, not at the throw. Mosh Pit (wiki/Mosh_Pit): inner radius 5.5 m (full damage; the outer ring to 6.2 m does half), a 3 s windup then 3 explosion ticks 0.1 s apart, so 3.3 s; the inner radius is used, the smaller of the two. The wiki gives no wall or ledge behaviour beyond 'most molotovs expand up to any walls and ledges', which the footprint already follows. Which zones count is decided in code (app/control/mollies.py), not here.
